title: THE STONE MEN OF SKAGOS // ANCIENT SACRIFICE
narrative: The Magnar of Skagos holds a carved obsidian sickle to Davos's throat: 'What does an onion lord have to trade for the blood of kings?' Davos reaches into his belt pouch and presents simple salt, parsnip seed, and honest iron nails. The cannibals laugh—a good, clean belly laugh—and pledge twenty galleys to the Onion Knight.

options.text: Sail the Skagosi fleet straight into White Harbor with Rickon.
Transport Tycho Nestoris's mercenary gold to the Wall.
